text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Hyaaah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I time Nakayama Festa as she runs up
and down
the sandy beach. She's making
noticeable
improvements during our
time here.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However...

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
The Japanese Oaks winner is gonna be
racing,
right? Where's she this time?
Sapporo?

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer B
text_block_list.text:
Yup. She's the uncontested favorite. If
she wins
today, next for her will be the
Arc.

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
She might be the one to bring home the
trophy
Japan's been dreaming of!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The position I wanted Nakayama Festa
to seize is
already occupied by another
Umamusume.
choice_data_list: （……周りの話題は別の子で一色だ）

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Becoming the first Japanese racer to
conquer the
Prix de l'Arc de
Triomphe—a dream coveted by
all
Japanese Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
No one anticipates Nakayama Festa's
appearance
on the grand stage. The risk
she's taking for her
mentor has gone
unnoticed.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Heads up and head up!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
You've got this, Nakayama! You're
gonna go take
down that Kyoto
crustacean, right?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
If ya wanna borrow the Golshi Cannon,
I'll cut ya
a sweet deal! Hurry and buy
me some melon
flavor shaved ice,
chop-chop!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Well, if I beat you at partner
running, I'll
take some strawberry ice
cream.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Hey, no fair! I want that flavor instead!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama Festa and Gold Ship are
preparing for
a partner run. I don't
remember putting this on
Nakayama's
schedule though...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Hurry up, Trainer. You need to decide
the track
before Golshi gets distracted.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Okay, a crab walking race it is! Let's do
this,
Nakayama!
choice_data_list: じゃあ力がつきそうな砂浜で！
根性が試されるトレッキングで

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Hey! No flying starts! Crabs don't have
wings!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Oopsie! ☆ You got me! All right, we can
get in
line then. ☆

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, that's taaasty! You really know
where it's
at!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hiking, working... Any other kings I
should know
about?!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, me. The king of kings. Think you
can beat
that, Golshi?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! Easy as pie! Here I go,
Nakayamaaa!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, that's taaasty! You really know
where it's
at!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In the end, the partner run ends without
a hitch,
almost as if it were part of our
plans.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Don't be ridiculous. It was just a

spur-of-the-moment thing.
choice_data_list: 俺が併走の約束忘れてたのかな……？
私が併走の約束忘れてたのかな……？

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Either way, it was experience I can put
to use at
the Kikuka Sho, seeing as
Golshi's specialty is
long distances.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Well, I wouldn't use the word "invite."
choice_data_list: じゃあ君からゴールドシップを誘って？
じゃあ貴方がゴールドシップを誘って？

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
One more strawberry ice cream! Oh, and
I'll take
fifty boxes of yakisoba as a
souvenir!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
It's more accurate to say she came to
hang out of
her own accord.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Just how long are you gonna stick
around,
Golshi?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
With you here, I can't have a serious
discussion.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: N-no way. I can't believe it...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
H-hey, you. What are you shouting for?
Did
something happen?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: The Arc...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Huh? What arc?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, the Oaks Umamusume won't
be
running in the Prix de l'Arc de
Triomphe after all...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It feels as if the rug was pulled out from
beneath
our society.

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer
text_block_list.text: Sigh... All the press about it sounds so glum... We all thought our shot was here.

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Her deciding she can't win will likely
discourage
other Umamusume from
trying.

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer
text_block_list.text:
I guess winning the Arc will remain only
a dream
for Umamusume in Japan.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Trainer, mind if I go for a quick run?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Escaping the gloomy atmosphere of the
summer
camp, I stand and watch
Nakayama Festa as she
silently runs laps.
choice_data_list: ああ、外の空気を吸いに行こう
うん、外の空気を吸いに行こう

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Now that Japan's top contender for the
Arc is
out, the passionate flames of race
enthusiasts at
home have shrunken to a
sputtering ember.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Hey, this spot taken?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Thanks a ton...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Everyone seems real gloomy, don't they?
This Arc
thing must've been a big deal.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama... though... she's planning to
go
international, right?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Interesting...
choice_data_list: ああ、今も目標にしているよ
うん、今も目標にしているよ

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Isn't there, like, a bunch of people
telling her she
can't, though? Isn't she
setting herself up for
failure?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
People can say it's impossible all they
want. It
doesn't sway us.
choice_data_list: そのムリは、他人が決めた基準だからかな

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
choice_data_list: 自分たちの基準だとまだ『できる』だから

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: What are you two chatting away about?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Ah! Nakayama!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Well, you see! Um, there was something
I wanted
to ask you!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
You know how some things are just
pointless to
waste your energy on? And,
like, no one's
cheering you on, because
no one's even
watching?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
So, like, you try and try, but it doesn't
end up
counting for anything. Happens
all the time,
right? So...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Does that ever really affect you?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Nah. What about you?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Charging into challenges headfirst isn't

meaningless. It's how you make miracles
happen.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Rather than fight the inevitable, I'd
rather burn
every last ember afforded to
me, so that when it's
all over, I'll have no
regrets.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I don't care what anyone else says. I'd
rather
struggle to survive than to kill my
passion and
give up.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...Um, I don't get it! Can you try talking
like a
normal person?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Struggle to survive"? What is that even
supposed
to mean? Ugh... Whatever!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: What's her problem?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Uh huh.
choice_data_list: 負けたくなかったんじゃないかな

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Hey, City. Know any good nail clinics? I
know my
nails are cute, but I want them
to be strong too.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Hm? Don't you mean to ask for any good nail salons?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
No. I want a clinic. Um... Please? You can
help
me, right?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I want to fix 'em before I get my next
manicure.
